item.name: Outworld Staff

effects.title: Self-Exile
effects.text: Makes the caster completely invulnerable and disabled for 0.7 seconds. When returning to the world, the caster takes 5% of their maximum health as damage.

notes: Damage taken when returning is non-lethal and disables Blink Dagger and other items that are muted upon taking damage.
item.lore: Proof that the lone sentinel was not always so.
